description: This source file defines enums and a configuration struct for push notification build settings, including transport mode, distribution mode, APNs environment, and relay URL. It provides initializers and utility functions to read these settings from an app bundle.

classes.name: PushBuildConfig
classes.description: A struct that encapsulates build configuration settings for push notifications, including transport mode, distribution mode, environment, and relay URL.

methods.name: init(bundle: Bundle)
methods.description: Initializes PushBuildConfig instance by reading configuration values from the specified bundle.

methods.name: usesRelay
methods.description: Boolean property indicating whether the relay transport mode is used.

methods.name: readURL(bundle:key:)
methods.description: Static method that reads and validates a URL string for a given key from the bundle.

methods.name: readEnum(bundle:key:fallback:)
methods.description: Generic static method that reads a string value from the bundle and converts it into a corresponding enum case, using a fallback if invalid or missing.
